title: SIBM in the crawler class: from a random field, wave-pinning cells form, make their own layer, self-polarize and crawl (seeds 0-2); the linear-kinetics twin never moves
summary: world.py = the world of 20261026T0243-c31-crawler-layer-repair-claim (Camley wave-pinning crawler, rho*=0.2, eta=2, per-body pools; layer species s made by the bound polarity protein, kp*phi*rho, adsorbed by the Langmuir flux; excluded cargo) started from an unstructured field: a smoothed white-noise field thresholded at area fraction 0.3 (31-33 random domains over the whole box, first frame of each sheet), rho = 1 +- 0.2 uniform noise inside, protein 2.64 per unit area, and each body's cytosolic concentration capped at 2.5. Labkit seeds 0-2, t=16: curvature flow and the polarity's area window leave 6-8 round cells by t~1-2, each with its own s ring; the larger ones break symmetry by themselves and crawl as half-moons, and a crawler that touches a static disk absorbs it, so each box ends with 1 large crawler (components final 1 on all 3 seeds). The s layer scores rim/core 2.5-3.5 and rim/out 6-9.5 (10-13 of 15-16 individuals membrane-like). Controls: SRC=none (pack_nosrc_s1): identical cells and motion, s flat; KIN=1 linear polarity kinetics (pack_linear_s0): all but one domain die and the survivor is a static disk that never moves (0 body lengths).

claims.statement: From a random two-phase field with noisy polarity (seeds 0, 1, 2), round cells form within t~1-2, each carrying a ring of its own layer species, and the larger ones self-polarize and crawl as half-moons with the ring held; crawlers absorb static cells they touch, so by t=16 each box holds one large crawler. Command: python -m labkit.run world.py --seeds <s> --frames 80 --no-movie.
claims.track: seed 1, pack/seed1/tracks.png: track #2 forms from the random field (t=0) and polarizes by t~1.6; track #32 is a layered half-moon crawler from t=1.2 to t=15 (70/81 frames for the longest track on this seed, 3.6 body lengths moved, FACTS.md); s membrane-like for #32 at mid-life

controls_run.B: SRC=none (pack_nosrc_s1): same cells and tracks, s flat (no radial structure)
controls_run.M: KIN=1 linear polarity kinetics (pack_linear_s0): no cell moves (max 0.0 body lengths), against 1.4-3.6 with the bistable kinetics

claims.bd_control: KIN=1 (linear relaxation instead of the bistable cubic) on seed 0: no motion; the layer itself was not diffusion-tested

limitations: The cyt cap (2.5) is a regularization: without it, protein left in shrinking fragments diverges and the run blows up; it removes protein from vanishing fragments only. The individuals coarsen: crawlers absorb static cells, so the population goes to one crawler per box and tracks are broken at each merge (persistent tracks 1-2 per seed; labkit's max body lengths 1.4-3.6 understate motion of the growing cell). No division, no repair tested from noise (the repair and cargo claims are on the planted cell, 20261026T0243). rho starts near the high state (1 +- 0.2), as in c22's self-polarizing disk; a mean-0.5 random rho start gave no survivors. The s layer counts under the L3 quasi-equilibrium clause because the cell's polarity protein makes all of it; its adsorption drift is written against phi.
